{{Top|leg|title=Heist on the ''Song of the Clouds''}}
A '''heist''' was carried out aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship|Ithorian herdship]] ''[[Song of the Clouds]]'' in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] by [[Cecil Noone's crew]]. [[Cecil Noone|Noone]] and his crew were tasked by [[Guttu]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to retrieve a mysterious box from the Bimm [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ritinki]] on the [[Ithorian Herdship]] ''[[Song of the Clouds]]''; while the box and its contents were successfully purloined, Noone's crew was forced to abandon their ship the ''[[Borogove]]'' and escape on Ritinki's yacht, the ''[[Asaari Wind]]''.
